[Intro]
[D5]

[Verse 1]
[D5]Gather the bones and lay
them in the sun in
patterns that capture the eye
No one could know, display
for everyone the
holes in our souls we despise
[F5]  [Eb5]
[D5]Timber and stone, mo-
numental,
remnants frozen in time
Carried alone
the burden, knowing it was
all we could do to survive
[F5]  [Eb5]

[E5]
Only embers re-

[Verse 2]
[D5]Scatter the dust, what we
once held in

Gone in a gust, not ours
to understand, ah,
agony perpetual
[F5]  [Eb5]
[D5]Holding my breath
and close my eyes, for a
second I can see you again
Motionless,
like that day we
lost who we both should have been
